# Reviewed package artifacts

These tarballs were produced with npm pack from the locally committed sources:

- @sunaissu/calculator 1.0.0: f4488ef
- @sunaissu/document-editor 1.0.0: 425df08
- @sunaissu/noteboard 2.0.1: 2ed1f7d

They include the unpublished reviewed changes while retaining each repository's
current package version. They are local integration artifacts, not npm releases.
package-lock.json records their integrity hashes. Replace them with published
version pins only after the corresponding package releases are available.
